description:
We are a bunch of high school STEM magnet students in Montgomery County, MD. 

Interested in Aerospace and Biomedical Engineering.
summary: Our design involves using AI and data structure systems to track an astronaut's health such as internal and external factors impacting a human body in space. By using sensors, inputs could be put into Java app, feeding into a Python data management file which would send the cleaned up data to a basic neural network made in Python as well as an SQL database for storage. The app would also determine the health conditions of the astronaut and store that data as well.
details: It takes inputs and provides conditions and stores cleaned up data using Python, SQL, and Java. We fully brainstormed the idea ourselves even though we knew the implementation would be difficult. We considered our time constraint as high school students, the difficulty of cleaning data using Python and developing an app in Java and communicating the data back to storage on Earth.
